svg.title: Two running hashes, one walk
svg.desc: Verification of [8,13) in the tree of size 14. Start: fr and sr are both the hash of entry 12. Step 1, entry 13 is a right sibling: only sr changes, sr = H(12, 13) = [12,14). Step 2, [8,12) is a left sibling inside the subtree: fr = H([8,12), 12) = [8,13) and sr = H([8,12), [12,14)) = [8,14). Step 3, [0,8) is a left sibling outside: only sr changes, sr = H([0,8), [8,14)) = the root. Accept if fr equals the claimed subtree hash, sr equals the root, and the position counter tn has reached zero.

text.tspan: accept when fr = claimed [8,13), sr = root, tn = 0
a right sibling lies outside the subtree, so it never touches fr. The bits of sn decide left or right.
